## TEST-DEC-LI-001 — Rechargeable lithium-ion fixture boundary

- Status: accepted test fixture; no legal classification effect.
- Include: finished rechargeable lithium-ion cells and modules.
- Exclude: primary lithium batteries, lead-acid/starter batteries, and battery parts.
- Historical treatment: one synthetic HTS10 line through 2021, split into two synthetic HTS10 lines from 2022.
- Quantity limitation: post-split lines report `No.` and `kg`; scope-level physical quantity is not comparable, but customs-value analysis remains valid.
- Implementation: `scopes/lithium-ion-cells-modules/v1/scope.csv`; this prose is not configuration or approval.
